title: As a founder, I can search available numbers by area code and buy a local number in minutes
As a founder, each number shows its voice, SMS, and MMS capability before I buy it
As a support leader, I can get numbers in the countries my customers call, with each country's documentation requirements stated up front
As a developer, I can search, buy, and configure phone numbers through a documented API
As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port
As a founder, a port shows its status and expected completion date, and a rejected port says why
As a founder, I can port my number out without lock-in fees, with the account details the gaining carrier needs available in the app
As a support leader, I can set business hours with open, closed, and holiday behavior per number
As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number
As a support leader, I can build a phone menu (press 1 for sales) that routes callers to teams
As a founder, I can forward the business number to a cell when the team is away from the desk
As a founder, voicemails are transcribed and delivered to email or chat so I can read them without dialing in
As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later
As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied
As a sales lead, I can send auto-replies and scheduled texts, like missed-call text-back and after-hours replies
As a developer, I can send and receive SMS on the number through the API with delivery status callbacks
As a founder, the product walks me through US A2P 10DLC brand and campaign registration and shows the approval status
As a founder, toll-free verification is a guided submission with visible status, and the product says texting stays blocked until approval
As a support leader, STOP and HELP keywords are handled automatically and opted-out contacts are suppressed from future sends
As a support leader, several teammates share one number with presence, conversation assignment, and internal threads
As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees
As a sales lead, calls and texts log to my CRM automatically against the right contact
As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems
As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate
As a founder, calls get AI summaries and transcripts attached to the conversation
As a support leader, an AI agent can answer the line, take a message, and hand off to a human
